title: The Nuremberg indictment is filed
body:
In Berlin, prosecutors from the United States, Britain, France, and the Soviet Union lodged an indictment against 24 leading Nazis before the new International Military Tribunal.

The trial itself opened in Nuremberg a month later.
photoNote: The opening session of the International Military Tribunal in Berlin, 18 October 1945, where the prosecution handed over the indictment. Office of the U.S. Chief of Counsel, public domain.

sources.title: Minutes of the opening session, Avalon Project, Yale Law School
